dedupe_keys.name: vc map virtual city systems 3d web map with open source vc map core

description: VC Map is a web application for viewing, analysing and simulating 3D city models, oblique aerial images and 2D geodata together in a browser, on desktop or mobile. Its core, published openly as @vcmap/core, wraps OpenLayers and CesiumJS and keeps data and user actions in step across 2D, 3D, oblique and panorama views, so tools written once work in all of them; it reads layers such as 3D Tiles. The product page lists search, drawing, height profiles, visibility analysis, a transparent surface mode to see underground pipes, split-screen comparison and shareable views. Coverage: used by cities and agencies with their own 3D data. Access: VC Map Core and UI are on GitHub (core version 6.3.10 in package.json, 7.0 release candidates tagged); the full suite with VC Publisher and other modules is sold by the company. Licence: MIT for VC Map Core. Caveats: the open core needs hosting and data; analysis modules such as solar and planning are separate products. Simulation uses are a 3D front end for building and public space digital twins, visibility and shadow checks and crisis management views. Related records: CesiumJS, 3DCityDB and CityGML.
